text:
Alex Kim: Quick check — we've got a gap in the EU-west reserved capacity for the Nov wave. Manifest shows 12 h100 nodes committed, but allocation shows only 9. @Mira @Sam can you confirm owner and whether we should shift region or add burst pool?
Mira Patel: Looking now. I thought we had 12 reserved but one was delayed by vendor. Checking PO and ETA.
Sam Ortiz: Confirmed vendor flagged 3 units as delayed last week. ETA is 'week of Nov 6' per logistics. I can ask for partial shipment to meet 12 by Nov 1 but need procurement sign-off.
Alex Kim: If partial helps, we should. Can procurement/finance approve a split invoice? @Jen Liao
Jen Liao: Finance: split invoice OK, but need updated PO reference and a reason code. @Sam send PO and vendor note.
Sam Ortiz: Pasting the vendor note:
```
PO: PO-4772
Vendor: NorthGrid
Delayed units: 3
Expected partial ship: 9 units on Oct 28, remaining 3 on Nov 8
```
I'll attach carrier tracking once I have it.
Mira Patel: Ok that maps to the reservation table. For routing: if EU-west only has 9 live nodes we should enable temporary routing to EU-central for canaries to avoid user-impact. Who owns routing policy?
Alex Kim: Routing policy is with eng-runtime for canaries and traffic shifts — @Ops Lead can you enable fallback to EU-central for the Nov 1 canary window?
Ops Lead: I can enable fallback. Need the list of routes and the expected traffic %. Also confirm SLA buckets for Dedicated vs Hosted during fallback.
Sam Ortiz: Routes: /v1/generate (dedicated-rr), /v1/embed (dedicated-rr). Expect canary 10% traffic to dedicated in EU during window. SLA: dedicated backed by reserved, hosted unaffected. I'll send exact route names to #eng-runtime config.
infra-bot: Reservation manifest updated by Sam Ortiz — 3 units delayed, ETA Nov 8. (link: https://incidents.internal/po-4772)
Jen Liao: Finance approved split invoice. Sam, include PO-4772a in the updated order.
Mira Patel: Ops Lead — once fallback is set, can you run a short smoke test with the canary set to 5% first? We want to verify latencies before bumping to 10%.
Ops Lead: Yep — will run 5% smoke at 09:00 UTC on Nov 1, then bump if metrics look fine. Which dashboards to watch?
Mira Patel: Watch per-route p95 latency, error-rate, and token-cost spike. Dashboards: /console/dashboards/dedicated/canary and /console/alerts/canary-slo
Alex Kim: Thanks. Last item: any blockers for getting burst pool enabled if vendor slips further?
Sam Ortiz: Procurement can request burst from cloud partner; need approval for on-demand spend. I'll draft the ask today and loop in finance.
Jen Liao: Finance: give me estimated on-demand spend and duration and I'll approve if within quarterly budget. cc @alex
Alex Kim: Sounds good. I'll coordinate the on-call schedule for the Nov 1 window — posting rotation in #oncall in 30m.
Mira Patel: One more — can eng-platform update the capacity calendar to flag partial-delivery and fallback policy? Helps downstream teams.
Alex Kim: Will sync with @eng-platform and update calendar. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
